title: Telugu Techie Dies of Heart Attack in Tampa at 35
excerpt: Sunil Kumar Gundrai, a Capgemini IT professional from Telangana, passed away on May 7 — NATS launches GoFundMe for his family.
body:
Sunil Kumar Gundrai, a Telugu-origin software professional working with Capgemini in Tampa, Florida, died of a sudden heart attack on the night of May 7, 2026. He was the sole breadwinner for his family, and leaves behind a wife and two young children.

**What happened:**
Sunil, a native of Gadwal in Telangana, had built his career in the United States driven by the values his father — a government school teacher back home — instilled in him. His death was sudden and unexpected, sending shockwaves through the Telugu diaspora in North America.

**Community rallies:**
The North America Telugu Society (NATS) moved quickly, launching a GoFundMe campaign through its NATS Helpline within days of his passing. The fundraiser targets immediate living and emergency expenses, funeral and household costs, and crucially, long-term educational support for his two young children. Sunil's death follows the cardiac arrest death of Indian student Mohammad Kumel Shaik in California just days earlier — a grim pattern that has alarmed the Indian-American community.

**What to watch:**
The GoFundMe campaign remains open; how much the Telugu diaspora mobilises in the coming weeks will reflect the community's capacity to support families that have no safety net beyond each other.
